mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_session (session_id, tenant_id, user_id, project_id, agent_id, current_intent, context_summary, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{projectId}, #{agentId}, #{currentIntent}, #{contextSummary}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_session SET user_id = #{userId}, project_id = #{projectId}, agent_id = #{agentId}, current_intent = #{currentIntent}, context_summary = #{contextSummary}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND session_id = #{sessionId}
